translationRepairs: Of old a great general's shame was Hong Hou in the cells;
Of old a great general's shame was Jiang Hou in the cells;
s0038 絳侯 is the marquisate title Jiang Hou (Zhou Bo); Hong Hou misreads 絳 as if it were 紅/洪, and the proposed idiomatic restores the correct name.
Of old a great general's shame was Hong Hou in a dungeon;
Of old a great general's shame was Jiang Hou in a dungeon;
The same 絳侯 in the literal of s0038 is Jiang Hou, not Hong Hou; the proposed replacement matches the Chinese title.
That is why the Grand Historian beat his breast to Heaven, wept his eyes dry, and still shed blood.
That is why Sir Shaoqing beat his breast to Heaven, wept his eyes dry, and still shed blood.
s0028 少卿 names Shaoqing (Ren An); Grand Historian would require 太史公/史遷, which this unit does not have, and the proposed idiomatic matches the already-correct literal.

He then impeached secretariat director Xie Tiao, minister of education left chief of staff Wang Ji, and protecting-army chief clerk Yu Hongyuan—for long illness and absence from the imperial tomb rites;

He then impeached secretariat director Xie Fei, minister of education left chief of staff Wang Ji, and protecting-army chief clerk Yu Hongyuan—for long illness and absence from the imperial tomb rites;
s0094 謝朏 is Xie Fei; Xie Tiao would be 謝朓, a different person, so the proposed idiomatic corrects the personal name.

Thereupon he impeached Secretariat Director Xie Tiao, Left Chief of Staff to the Minister of Education Wang Ji, and Protecting Army Chief Clerk Yu Hongyuan—all for long illness and failure to attend the mountain tomb rites;

Thereupon he impeached Secretariat Director Xie Fei, Left Chief of Staff to the Minister of Education Wang Ji, and Protecting Army Chief Clerk Yu Hongyuan—all for long illness and failure to attend the mountain tomb rites;
Literal likewise misreads 謝朏 as Xie Tiao; replacing with Xie Fei restores the correct name without other change.
His son Qian took the title, rose from Danyang aide to magistrate of Changcheng, then lost the fief for a crime.
His son Wei took the title, rose from Danyang aide to magistrate of Changcheng, then lost the fief for a crime.
s0106 子蒍 names the son 蒍 (Wei); Qian is unsupported, and the proposed idiomatic restores the correct given name.
His son Qian inherited the fief; from Assistant to the Danyang Intendant he became magistrate of Changcheng; for a crime his noble rank was stripped.
His son Wei inherited the fief; from Assistant to the Danyang Intendant he became magistrate of Changcheng; for a crime his noble rank was stripped.
The same 蒍 in the literal of s0106 is Wei, not Qian; the proposed replacement matches the Chinese personal name.
In Putong year 4 Gaozu remembered Yan's service and made Qian marquis of Wuchang again, with the old fief.
In Putong year 4 Gaozu remembered Yan's service and made Wei marquis of Wuchang again, with the old fief.
s0107 復封蒍吳昌伯 again names 蒍 (Wei); Qian is a mistranslation, and Wei is the correct given name.
In the fourth year of Putong, Gaozu recalled Yan's merit and re-enfeoffed Qian as Marquis of Wuchang, fief as before.
In the fourth year of Putong, Gaozu recalled Yan's merit and re-enfeoffed Wei as Marquis of Wuchang, fief as before.
Literal of s0107 likewise has 蒍, not a name Qian; re-enfeoffing Wei as Marquis of Wuchang matches the Chinese.
His friend Dao Gai of Pengcheng—Gai's younger brother He—had roamed mountains and streams with him.
His friend Dao Gai of Pengcheng—Gai's younger brother Qia—had roamed mountains and streams with him.
s0166 溉弟洽 names Gai’s younger brother 洽 (Qia); He is unsupported, and the proposed idiomatic restores the correct name.
His friend Dao Gai of Pengcheng—Gai's younger brother He—had roamed mountains and streams with Fang.
His friend Dao Gai of Pengcheng—Gai's younger brother Qia—had roamed mountains and streams with Fang.
The same 洽 in the literal of s0166 is Qia, not He; the proposed replacement matches the Chinese personal name.
So Wu Yuan was washed by Zai Pi; Zhang and Wang spread wings at Chen's minister.
So Wu Yuan was washed by Zai Pi; King Zhang spread wings under Chancellor Chen.
s0238 張王撫翼於陳相 pairs title King Zhang with Chancellor Chen; reading 張王 as surnames Zhang and Wang invents a second person and misreads 陳相, and the proposed idiomatic restores both titles.
So Wu Yuan was washed by Zai Pi, Zhang and Wang spread wings at Chen's minister.
So Wu Yuan was washed by Zai Pi, King Zhang spread wings under Chancellor Chen.
Literal likewise misreads 張王 and 陳相 as “Zhang and Wang” and “Chen’s minister”; King Zhang under Chancellor Chen matches the Chinese titles.

If the scale cannot lift and the gossamer cannot fly, though Yan and Ran had dragon sinews and phoenix pinions, Zeng and Shi orchid scent and snow-white, Shu and Xiang jade and gold, Yuan and Yun abyss-sea, He and Han brocade and Milky Way—they are wandering dust.

If the scale cannot lift and the gossamer cannot fly, though Yan and Ran had dragon sinews and phoenix pinions, Zeng and Shi orchid scent and snow-white, Shu and Xiang gold, jade, and the abyss-sea, Qing and Yun embroidery and the Milky Way—they are wandering dust.

s0242 舒、向金玉，淵海卿、雲，黼黻河漢 pairs Shu/Xiang with 金玉淵海 and Qing/Yun (卿、雲) with 黼黻河漢; Yuan, He, and Han are invented person names. The proposal’s bracketing is awkward, so the metaphors are kept without editorial brackets.

If the scale cannot lift and the gossamer cannot fly, though Yan and Ran had dragon sinews and phoenix pinions, Zeng and Shi orchid scent and snow-white, Shu and Xiang jade and gold, Yuan and Yun abyss-sea, He and Han brocade and Milky Way—they are seen as wandering dust.

If the scale cannot lift and the gossamer cannot fly, though Yan and Ran had dragon sinews and phoenix pinions, Zeng and Shi orchid scent and snow-white, Shu and Xiang gold, jade, and the abyss-sea, Qing and Yun embroidery and the Milky Way—they are seen as wandering dust.
Literal of s0242 has the same false persons Yuan/He/Han; Qing and Yun with embroidery and the Milky Way is correct, without the proposal’s awkward brackets.
Thus wherever carriage wheels travel, it is not Bo Yi and Hui Shi's house;
Thus wherever carriage wheels travel, it is not Bo Yi and Liu Xiahui's house;
s0245 夷、惠 is the conventional pair Bo Yi and Liu Xiahui (柳下惠); Hui Shi would be 惠施 and is a different allusion, so Liu Xiahui is the correct identification.
Thus wherever carriage wheels travel, it cannot be Bo Yi and Hui Shi's house;
Thus wherever carriage wheels travel, it cannot be Bo Yi and Liu Xiahui's house;
Literal likewise misreads 惠 as Hui Shi; with 夷 it is Liu Xiahui, and the proposed replacement matches that reading.
Of all those arm-clasping heroes, those gold-and-orchid friends—not one wept Yangshe Xi's tears below the bier; who would divide a house as Zou did for Cheng's orphans?
Of all those arm-clasping heroes, those gold-and-orchid friends—not one wept Yangshe Xi's tears below the bier; who would emulate Hou Chengzi's virtue of dividing his house?

s0273 郈成分宅之德 is Hou Chengzi’s virtue of dividing his residence; Zou and Cheng are a false split. The proposal names Hou Chengzi correctly but “divide a house with … virtue” misses 慕…之德, so the phrasing is revised to emulate that virtue.
Of all those arm-clasping heroes, those gold-and-orchid friends of old—not one wept Yangshe Xi's tears below the bier; who now would divide a house as Zou did for Cheng's orphans?
Of all those arm-clasping heroes, those gold-and-orchid friends of old—not one wept Yangshe Xi's tears below the bier; who now would emulate Hou Chengzi's virtue of dividing his house?
Literal of s0273 likewise invents Zou and Cheng from 郈成; keep Hou Chengzi and render 慕…分宅之德 as emulating his virtue of dividing his house.
